description: List your weekly AI action plans — suggested action items generated from your competitors' latest moves, each with angle, urgency, confidence, the evidence behind it, and a ~30-minute first step. Each item carries status (active/completed); items you ignored are omitted. Newest first, paginated; use limit 1 for just the current plan.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0); use next_offset from the previous page

since.description: Only plans generated on/after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-06-01)

name: outmano_list_action_plans

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; absent on the last page

action_items.description: Sorted by urgency; items you ignored are omitted

evidence.description: The competitor moves behind the item

next_step_30_min.description: A first step that fits in about 30 minutes

no_action_angles.description: Angles with nothing to do this week
